_comment: OLL-04 and OLL-05 of the 2026-11-20 managed Ollama campaign (docs/audits/platform-parity/2026-11-20-managed-ollama/report.md). `cases`: one install failure's evidence line, as the driver named in `os` writes it, and the class _shared/ai/data/ollama_install_errors.json gives it; every driver replays every case, since the rule is one. `free_space`: the pinned asset's bytes, its unpacked bytes, the registry margin and the free bytes of the install volume, and whether the download may start. Replayed by windows/tests/unit/ai/servers/test_ollama_install_errors.ahk, linux/tests/unit/ai/engine/ollama/test_install_errors.lua and macos/tests/unit/ai/engine/ollama/test_install_errors.lua, the macOS free-space rule by tools/test/macos_managed_ollama_install_errors_test.py.
